jobs.name: menu-breakfasts-15.png
jobs.prompt:
Create an isolated prop sheet for a children's family food guide.
Style: handmade European picture-book PAPER COLLAGE. Matte fibrous colored paper, simple flat hand-cut shapes, subtly irregular scissor-cut edges, shallow soft shadows between overlapping paper layers. Restrained mint, forest green, sage, cream, mustard and terracotta palette. Food is built from flat paper pieces, calm texture, no realistic surfaces.
References: image 1 = paper material; image 2 = how food dishes are presented. Match their material and plate style.
Subject: exactly 15 different breakfast dishes, each on its own simple cream paper plate, bowl, jar or board, seen from a 3/4 top-down view, in this order:
1 cottage cheese pancakes (syrniki) with berries; 2 overnight oats in a glass jar with apple and berries; 3 three egg muffins with peppers and spinach; 4 thin crepes folded into envelopes with cottage cheese; 5 buckwheat with milk and grated apple in a bowl; 6 wholegrain toast with a soft egg and cucumber slices; 7 cottage cheese with banana slices and granola in a bowl; 8 small banana pancakes in a stack with yogurt; 9 two squares of cottage cheese casserole with raisins; 10 a board with open sandwiches: cheese, chicken, cucumber, tomato; 11 millet porridge with pumpkin cubes in a bowl; 12 a breakfast burrito cut in half showing scrambled egg and pepper; 13 a glass of yogurt parfait with granola and berries; 14 a toasted sandwich with turkey and cheese cut diagonally; 15 a glass of banana-berry smoothie next to a boiled egg.
Layout: grid 5 columns × 3 rows, large even gaps, every dish fully separated, no lines, no labels, no text.
Constraints: no realistic food photography, no glossy 3D, no black outlines, no lettering, no logos, no watermarks.
Output: PNG with real transparent alpha background.
Material quality check: quiet mostly smooth matte paper, no all-over noise, wrinkles, crumpled embossing or photorealistic food. Clearly separable flat hand-cut layers and short soft shadows at overlaps. Preserve exact requested item order. High-resolution landscape sheet, aim 3000 × 1800 or larger. Each grid cell depicts a fully prepared recognisable dish, NOT a generic divided ingredient plate.
jobs.qa: 15 prepared dishes, 5x3; material rebuilt in two additional passes.
